web.top: The cover: Ruben Costa, a full-stack developer who builds web apps end to end, from the database to the interface.
web.ch01: Episode 1: Minecraft servers with friends, aged 12 to 15. None shipped, but it was his first try at building something for other people.
web.ch02: Episode 2: Animes Cold, an anime Discord server. He built two bots for it, Estela for moderation and Emilia-Tan for the community, plus a website.
web.ch03: Episode 3: self-taught alongside a vocational IT course, then PathPals as his PAP, and now the last subject of a CTeSP at IPCB.
web.work: The four projects, in the order he built them: PathPals, Manager, Budget Builder and GeekHatch. Each card opens a full case study.
web.skills: The skill tree: frontend, backend, data and engineering practices. Every skill names the project that proves it.
web.offscreen: Side quests: games, films and anime, and what shaped him: Spider-Man, Re:Zero, Fight Club and The Social Network.
web.ch04: Now: finishing his CTeSP, looking for a first full-stack role, building Budget Builder and running the GeekHatch beta.
web.credits: Contact: copy his email, or find him on GitHub (Ice-San) and LinkedIn. His CV is here too.
